independent_adversarial_observations.meaning: These are limitations of the deliberately small S1 toy, which neither validates backward causal input nor guards missing lineage. Production must reject impossible/dangling mandatory lineage or return safe unknown/unavailable; these outputs cannot certify complete known origin ancestry.

limitations: Semantic digest covers only S1/S3/S4, not S5; deterministic S5 fields compared separately.
S1 hidden-input function deliberately ignores hidden input; equality is a supplied-projection demonstration, not an authorization proof.
S3 tests a pure table and selected dictionary keys, not persisted grants, acquisition or real referral.
S4 tests fixed already-known acyclic supports and unchanged stance, not a complete support index/cascade or holder authorization implementation.

S5 stages serialize request witness plus poststate; no cold full-prefix rederivation, uncertain publication, independent receipt verification, real successor source/profile, or process/whole-volume fault was executed.
Tracemalloc peaks are JSON cold-decode Python allocation measurements, not full process memory or successor capacity.
